text: Internal medicine is one of the core disciplines of clinical medicine, mainly studying the etiology, pathogenesis, clinical manifestations, diagnosis, treatment and prevention of diseases in various systems and organs of the human body. Through the study of this course, students willMaster the diagnosis and treatment principles of common internal medicine diseases and establish a systematic clinical thinking.Be familiar with the pathophysiological mechanism of diseases and understand the application of "evidence-based medicine" in clinical decision-making.Cultivate comprehensive analytical abilities and learn to combine basic medical knowledge with clinical practice.
